newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow on Thursday, USDA said. Few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry good, demand fair.

Sales confirmed on 1,900 slaughter steers and 3,500 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 35,900 head confirmed including 19,900 head or about 55 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1275 lbs 65.00, pen 1200 lb cutting bulls 64.50. Slaughter heifers -
few Select and Choice 2-3 975-1150 lbs 65.00; few Select with end Choice 64.00.
Wk to date - 35,900 last week - 108,100 last year - 73,300
